source.citation: Sanborn Map Company. Insurance Maps of Chicago, Illinois, Vol. 3 (1911), sheet 28: E. 18th St. to E. 20th St., Prairie Av. Blvd. and Calumet Av. to the Illinois Central / Michigan Central tracks and Lake Michigan. Scale 1" = 50'. Stamped 'Fire Insurance Map Collection, Geography and Map Division, Library of Congress'; header 'Chicago Vol. 3', with 1891-edition cross-references (245-246) (252-253).

the 1904 use of the west wing: '1911 GARAGE' cannot be backdated
architecture above the footprint - roof pitches, chimneys, openings
lot dimensions in figures for this lot: none are printed on it
what_it_supplies: the house's position on its lot: north face on the E. 18th Street line, west face on the alley line, east face about 14.7 ft (±1.5 ft) behind the Prairie Avenue street line
a check on the HABS envelope: about 161 x 75 ft overall and a 35 x 59 ft west wing at 1" = 50'
materials by colour (stone street walls, brick courtyard walls) and storeys (2B main house, 1½ west wing) in 1911
